## Simple Blockquote

> This is a simple blockquote.
> It can span multiple lines.
> All lines are part of the same quote.

## Blockquote with Formatting

> This blockquote has **bold text** in it.
> It also has *italic text* and `code spans`.
> Links work too: [example](https://example.com).

## Nested Blockquotes

> This is a top-level blockquote.
> > This is a nested blockquote.
> > > This is a double-nested blockquote.
> >
> > Back to first nesting level.
>
> Back to top level.

## Blockquote with Lists

> This blockquote contains a list:
> - First item
> - Second item
> - Third item
>
> And more text after the list.

## Blockquote with Code

> Here's an example:
>
> ```csharp
> var pres = new Presentation();
> ```
>
> Use this pattern in your code.

## Multiple Blockquotes

> First blockquote.

> Second blockquote.

> Third blockquote.

## Blockquote with Headings

> ### Heading in Blockquote
>
> This is content under the heading.
>
> #### Subheading
>
> More content here.
